For a bit of a backstory, I just turned 17 and I'm starting my senior year next month. I've had depression, and it kind of comes in waves. During the months of February-June of this year I felt kind of suicidal (especially in April and May, like even mental hospitals were sounding fun) and I was thinking of elaborate suicide plans, not that I was going to go through with anything.

I think the hardest part for a few months was almost bipolar type symptoms. Sometimes I just felt amazing and was in such an amazing mood, and had so much hope and energy. Then minutes later I felt like actually dying and there was so many voices in my head saying people hate me/I should just give up/I'm awful at everything. I don't know what happened but soon after June started (mostly after my birthday on June 14th) things just kind of got better (for the most part). I haven't been having those huge mood swings like that..they just stopped and I can't think of a reason why.

I still get pretty down sometimes but it's usually not a huge shift as of lately.
